name: lin_nilpotent_det_one_add
statement: (n k : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : A ^ k = 0) : Matrix.det (1 + A) = 1
closed: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (h : A ^ k = 0), Matrix.det (1 + A) = 1
informal: For a nilpotent real matrix A, det(I + A) = 1 — the characteristic polynomial of a nilpotent matrix over a domain is X^n; evaluate det(tI − A) at t = −1 (and fix signs), or show det(I + tA) is a polynomial unit in t hence constant.
type: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ), A ^ k = 0 → (1 + A).det = 1
